run_html_to_markdown: run the CLI tool to convert LaTeX-ML HTML files to markdown using --html and --out flags
run_check_file_path: run check_file_path to validate a list of file paths and return only those that exist
run_glob_file_paths: run check_file_path with glob patterns to resolve wildcard file paths against a working directory
review_check_file_path: review the check_file_path function that resolves paths with optional working directory and glob support
refactor_html_parsing: refactor the main block HTML parsing pipeline to handle additional error cases during LaTeX-ML conversion
